subject: Music Production
title: Auditory Illusions
description: A quick, practical guide to Auditory Illusions.

hook.text: The Shepard tone sounds like an endlessly rising pitch, even though it loops back continuously.

buildup.text: It layers multiple octaves of a rising tone so the brain perceives constant upward movement.

discovery.text: Auditory illusions prove that what you hear depends as much on your brain as on your ears.

twist.text: Film composers use the Shepard tone to build tension that feels like it never resolves.

climax.text: Producers use psychoacoustic tricks to make mixes feel bigger, wider, or more exciting.

punchline.text: A sound that seems to rise forever is just a trick.

quiz.question: How does the Shepard tone create the illusion of endless rising?
options: By layering multiple octaves of a rising tone
By speeding up the tempo gradually
